addressReference.description: Existing address endpoint for the quoted exact-address query.

independentPropertyReference.description: Existing independently established property endpoint, or null.

artifactFileReferencesBySha256.description: Maps the verified Firecrawl FileRef digest to an existing file endpoint.

materializationRules.source: Firecrawl ResultManifest plus immutable acquisition metadata
requirements: registrationId is an approved Firecrawl property-page-evidence configuration
inputJson preserves property_reference and exact_address_query without credentials
primaryRawArtifactUri and primaryRawArtifactSha256 copy the Connect FileRef exactly
outcome and transport status are copied without sale classification
artifactOrdinal is 0 and artifactRole is raw
sourceUri and sha256 copy the Connect FileRef exactly
bodyText is the exact UTF-8 decoded envelope and its sha256 remains the digest of the original bytes
the page array is not exploded or interpreted during packaging
one Firecrawl envelope may contain zero through three web pages
Transform POSEXPLODE emits one observation per page or one failure/empty sentinel
each page evaluates at most sixteen JSON-LD blocks of at most 262144 characters each
status, date, exact address, and price remain scoped to one eligible JSON-LD block
the dependent assessment consumes target_listing_observations in the same Glue execution
the exactly-one completion projection rejects cross-subject batches

prohibited: commercial or customer HTML in source control
search rank or domain used as authority
visible text, OpenGraph tags, or unscoped application state used as active status
mapping identifiers, language versions, formats, or output datasets added to Transform wire requests
provider status, address, price, or availability interpretation in Connect or System packaging
